title: Among users who own posts tagged with 'r' and have a reputation over 1000,
question: Among users who own posts tagged with 'r' and have a reputation over 1000, find the one who received the most negative comments (score < 60) on their posts. Return their display name and the total number of such negative comments.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name, COUNT(c."XCL_005") AS negative_comment_count
FROM users AS u
JOIN posts AS p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
JOIN tags AS t ON t."XCL_050" = p."XCL_026" AND t."XCL_048" = 'r'
JOIN comments AS c ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026" AND c."XCL_007" < 60
WHERE u."XCL_053" > 1000
GROUP BY u."XCL_052", u."XCL_055"
ORDER BY negative_comment_count DESC
LIMIT 1
